top_counterbore_depth = 10.0

inner_radius = outer_radius - wall_thickness

            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (chute_width, 0))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=chute_length)

    solid_body = solid_body - slot
